chunks: And Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said:
Regarding the nine categories: “If you convert them within the year, then nothing is due upon you concerning them.”

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja‘far, Imam Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.التِّسْعَةِ: the nine categories recognized as liable for zakat
key_terms.السَّنَةِ: the year; the zakat year under consideration
key_terms.حَوَّلْتَهَا: you converted or changed them into another form
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: anything; here meaning any due obligation

ai.seo_question: If zakat-liable property is converted into another form during the year, is zakat still due?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the nine categories subject to zakat. It states that if such property is converted into another form during the course of the year, then no zakat is due on it for that period.
